name: Miyazu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyazu city emblem in maroon: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes, like the character 宮.
history: Municipal flag of Miyazu, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 August 1954.

features.role: Miyazu city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes, like the character 宮
